description: Add multi-delivery tracking (associate multiple deliveries with one request over time), implement reallocation button on inventory page that triggers allocation including outstanding demand, and update delivery confirmation to properly increment total_received and update request status
steps: 1. Verify deliveries table already supports multiple deliveries per request_id (it does based on schema exploration - no changes needed). Each delivery record links to a request via request_id.

2. Update advance_delivery() route in app.py: when advancing to 'Delivered' status, increment total_received on the request by the delivery quantity, then check remaining demand and set status to 'Partially Fulfilled' if remaining > 0 or 'Fulfilled' if remaining = 0. This was partially done in FEAT-001, ensure it's complete.
3. Update delivery_feedback() route in app.py: when relief user confirms receipt (confirmed=1), also increment total_received if not already done, and update request status appropriately.

4. Add a 'Reallocate Outstanding Demand' button to inventory.html that links to /admin/allocations with a flash message explaining that both new pending requests and outstanding demand from partially fulfilled requests will be included.

5. Update allocations.html template to clearly distinguish between new requests (status='Pending') and reallocations (status='Partially Fulfilled'). Use visual indicators like a blue 'NEW' pill for pending and orange 'REALLOCATION' pill for partially fulfilled.

6. Update admin_deliveries.html and my_deliveries.html templates to show which delivery number this is for the request (1st delivery, 2nd delivery, etc). Query deliveries grouped by request_id with a row number or count.

7. Add a note/card in allocations.html explaining the reallocation workflow: 'This allocation includes both new requests and outstanding demand from partially fulfilled requests. Each request is prioritized by the same scoring system regardless of whether it's new or a reallocation.'

8. Test the complete multi-delivery workflow: submit request → partial allocation → dispatch/deliver → receive new stock → reallocate → dispatch/deliver second batch → verify request shows 'Fulfilled' when remaining demand reaches 0.
acceptance_criteria: A single request can have multiple delivery records over time
Each delivery (when marked 'Delivered') increments total_received on its parent request
Request status automatically updates from 'Partially Fulfilled' to 'Fulfilled' when remaining demand reaches 0
Inventory page has 'Reallocate Outstanding Demand' button that links to allocations
Allocations page visually distinguishes new requests from reallocations
Delivery pages show which delivery number this is (1st, 2nd, etc.) for multi-delivery requests
verification: Delete reliefgrid.db, run python app.py, login as admin
Submit a request for 100 units (or use seed data), apply allocation when only 60 units available
Navigate to /admin/deliveries, advance the delivery to 'In Transit' then 'Delivered'
Verify request status changes to 'Partially Fulfilled' and total_received = 60
Click 'Reallocate Outstanding Demand' button from inventory page
Verify allocation plan shows the partially fulfilled request with remaining demand of 40 units
Apply allocation, advance the second delivery to 'Delivered'
Verify request status changes to 'Fulfilled' and total_received = 100
Check deliveries page and confirm both deliveries are visible and numbered/distinguishable
